figures.caption: Fig. 1 (a) Crystal structure of argyrodite Li6PS5X (X ¼ Cl, Br or I). Single anions (S2 and X) form a face-centered cubic lattice (Wyckoﬀ4a) and half of the tetrahedral voids (Wyckoﬀ4c) with PS4 3 polyanions in the octahedral sites (Wyckoﬀ4b). Li ions are partially occupied at Wyckoﬀ24g and 48h sites around Wyckoﬀ4c sites of single anions in the form of a pseudo-octahedral cage (4c-cage). (b) Li ion network structure consists of 4c-cages and 4a-cages, where the 4c-cage has a tetrahedral arrangement and the 4a-cage is in the center of the tetrahedron.

figures.caption: Figure S1. Schematic workflow of AIMD simulations to obtain ionic conductivity (σRT) at room temperature.
